t: Bekol beraka tzarik sheyyihyeh shem umalkut
s: Bekol beraka tzarik sheyyihyeh shem umalkut, ubo b' seipim: kol beraka sheen bah hazkarat hashshem — enah beraka. Vekol berakot happotechot be"baruk" — tzarik lomar gam malkut biptichatan, veim lav — lo yatza. Chutz mibberaka rishona shel tepillat y"ch, sheenah hodaa al hanaa, o mitzva, ella al tebiat tzerakayv shel adam, kede sheyyesadder shebachayv shel maqom veachar kak yitpallel, lepikak lo tiqqenu bah malkut. Veken bebirkot meen sheba shebbelel shabbat, hoil upetichatah hi meen beraka rishona shel tepillat y"ch:

Apillu im lo dilleg ella tebat "haolam" lebad — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, she"melek" lebaddo eno chashub malkut (ki en lo beur kelal belo tebat "haolam" shehu samuk alehem, sheim timtze lomar shehu musab al tebat "elohenu", kelomar she"elohenu" hu "melek" — en zo kavvanat chakamim shettiqqenu malkut bibrakot, ella sheyyihyeh musab al "baruk" shebbitchillat habberaka, kelomar "baruk melek haolam", shehare mesayyem "shehakkol ku'", o "asher ku'", o "sheasa ku'", shekkol zeh musab al "baruk", ukesheeno omer "haolam" — eno musab al "baruk" ella tebat "Hashem elohenu", abal "melek" nishar lebaddo, ella im ken haya omer "hammelek". Veim timtze lomar she"melek" musab lematta, "melek sheasa ku'", o "melek shehakkol ku'" — gam zo enah kavvanat chakamim bematbea habberakot, ella sheshshear habberaka yehe musab al "hashshem" shehu iqqar habberaka, velo al "melek" lebad):
